Ebony Closed Helm is a helmet in that is a part of ebony armor set.
Ebony Cuirass is a piece of armor in . It can not be purchased from any merchants.
Ebony Left Bracer is a piece of heavy armor and part of the ebony armor set in .
Ebony Left Pauldron is piece of heavy armor and part of the Ebony Armor set in .
Ebony Right Pauldron is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Ebony Armor set.
Ebony Ceremonial Gauntlets is a type of Armor found in . They can be found in a display case on the second floor of the Cheydinhal Fighters Guild.
Ebony Ceremonial Shield is a shield found in . It serves as decoration in display cases in houses throughout Cyrodiil.
Ebony Warrior is a mysterious Redguard warrior in who wears a full set of ebony armor.
Eddard's Wrath is a Destruction spell in that damages a victim's armor and weapons.
Ebony Scimitar is a one-handed long blade that is carried by High Ordinators throughout Mournhold.
Ebony Arrow of Slaying is an arrow that is intended to be used with a bow in .
Edhelas is a Bosmer residing in a ship called The Prowler, in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.

Ebon Armory is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be obtained in Crypt of Hearts. Generic armor pieces are in the Ebon Style, while other generic pieces are in the Soul-Shriven Style.
Ebonthread Armor is a type of light armor in . It is the fifth type of light armor available to craft in the clothing skill line. The Ebonthread armor is the appropriate armor for levels 46-50.
Echo Weapon is a spell in . Echo Weapon and other last Skills can only be learned up to one level. This does not mean that a higher level cannot be accessed, just not upgraded and learned.
Ebony Light Hammers are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot or crafted at a blacksmith of level 8. It is a light, bashing weapon.
Ebony Hand Axes are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot or crafted at a blacksmith of level 8. It is a light, slashing weapon.
Ebony Helm is a piece of plate helm armor in that protects the head.
Ebony Pauldron (R) is a piece of plate right pauldron armor in that protects the right shoulder and upper arms.
Ebony Plate Armor is a set of heavy armor in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Ebony Plate Creation Club content.
Ebony Plate Boots is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Ebony Plate Creation Club content.
Ebony Plate Gauntlets is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Ebony Plate Creation Club content.
Ebony Plate Helmet is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Ebony Plate Creation Club content.
Ebony Spell Knight Armor is a set of heavy armor in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Ebony Spell Knight Boots is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Ebony Spell Knight Gauntlets is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Ebony Spell Knight Helmet is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Eleidon's Ward is a unique shield in . According to Tamrielic Lore, it was crafted for Eleidon, a Breton holy knight of legends, as a reward for the rescue of a Baron's daughter.
Elf-Skerring is a large transport ship in the Sadrith Mora docks owned by a Dunmer named Gals Arethi. It can take the Nerevarine to Dagon Fel, Ebonheart, Molag Mar and Tel Mora.

Elberoth's Saber is a unique one-handed weapon in . It is received from Apronia Alfena during the East Empire Company quest "Supply Route Problems" and is required to successfully intimidate Baro Egnatius.
Electric Shell is an apprentice-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's shock resistance and armor rating by 10% for 30 seconds.

Elberoth is a deceased Bosmer captain who was running supplies for Raven Rock. His ship crashed on the coast, when the crew were attacked by draugr. Elberoth and the rest of the crew were killed. Apronia Alfena is the only survivor from the stranded Supply Ship.
Elf Bane is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
Elemental Storm is a Weapon-Skill Ultimate that was introduced into as of Update 12.
Elemental Rage is a Weapon-Skill Ultimate that was introduced into as of Update 12.
Elemental Catalyst is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor Hazardous Alchemy Style set, and can be found in Stone Garden.
Eldertide Fenwitches are hostile Breton members of the Eldertide Circle in located at the Coral Cliffs. They wield two-handed weapons and wear medium armor in the updated Barbaric Style.
Eldertide Vinecallers are hostile Breton members of the Eldertide Circle in located at the Coral Cliffs. They wield one-handed weapons and wear light armor in the updated Barbaric Style.
Elemental Force is a passive skill in the Destruction Staff skill line in .

Elven Armor is an elegant armor set made by the High Elves of Summerset Isle. The armor is light but durable, and is known for its unique style and maneuverability. This armor can be applied to the Hero's horse if the proper add-on is installed.
The Elven Shield is a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Armor set.
The Elven Cuirass is a piece of light armor. It starts to appear at level 20 in random loot and may be worn by enemies.
Elven Greaves are a type of light armor legwear in . The greaves will start to appear at level 20 in random loot, and may also be worn by enemies.
The Elven Dagger is a weapon that appears in . The design of the Elven dagger originated in Alinor.
Elven Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Armor set found in .
An Elven Helmet is a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Armor set found in .
Elven Gauntlets are a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Armor set found in .

Elven Gilded Armor is a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Armor set found in . It is identical in appearance to Elven Armor, but possesses a higher armor rating. As of patch 1.9, wearing this armor will count towards the "Matching Set" perk achieved at level 70 in the Light Armor skill tree.

Elven Light Gauntlets are a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Light Armor set found in . They are identical to their regular counterparts, however they have a slightly lower armor rating and provide the same protection as Leather Bracers.

Elven Light Armor is a piece of light armor and part of the Elven light armor set found in . It is almost identical to its regular and gilded counterparts, however it lacks pauldrons and it weighs less. It only provides a little more protection than leather armor.

Elven Light Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Light Armor set found in . They are identical to their regular counterparts, however they have a slightly lower armor rating and provide the same protection as Leather Boots.

The Elven Light Helmet is a piece of light armor and part of the Elven Light Armor set found in . It is identical to its regular counterpart, however they have a slightly lower armor rating which provides the same protection as leather helmet.
Elven Hero Armor is a discontinued costume for formerly available through the Crown Store. It was later re-released for a limited time as a legendary reward from Dwarven Crown Crates.
Embershield is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in City of Ash. Generic pieces are in the Daedric Style.
Elven Hand Axes are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, cleaving weapon.
Elven Light Hammers are weapons found in . They can be gathered as loot, or crafted at the blacksmith. It is a light, bashing weapon.
Elven Helm is a piece of plate helm armor in that protects the head.
Elven Pauldron (L) is a piece of plate armor in that protects the left shoulder and upper arms.
Elven Right Pauldron is an armor piece in , protecting the shoulder and arm.
Elven Hunter Armor is a set of light armor in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Elven Hunter Creation Club content.
Elven may refer to: *The elven races, also called Mer *Elven Armor *Elven Weapons

Enchanted Armor is armor that has been enchanted with magic effects. In general, these items appear as random loot throughout Morrowind. Several of these items also have a small number of static occurrences. The vast majority are based on common items and are identical in physical appearance to their un-enchanted counterparts.

Eorlund Gray-Mane is a Nord blacksmith and is widely considered to be the best blacksmith in Skyrim, forging weapons and armor for The Companions at the Skyforge in Whiterun. However, he is not a direct member of the Companions. Eorlund can usually be found working at the Skyforge, just north of Jorrvaskr, up the stairs. He is normally seen crafting Skyforge Weapons for The Companions.
The Enthralled Wizards are Nord and Redguard ghosts in who are found in Labyrinthian during the quest "The Staff of Magnus."

The Enhanced Crossbow is an Archery weapon that is identical to the regular crossbow in appearance and damage, but ignores 50% of armor. It is also heavier than the latter and has a higher base value.
Eorim the Hammer is a Nord member of the Stormfist Clan found in the Old Sord's Cave.

Er Jaseen's Worn Jack is a piece of medium armor in obtained from the Sealed Urn after completing the quest "Soul Shriven in Coldharbour." It was previously worn by Er-Jaseen who sacrificed himself to allow the Vestige and Lyris Titanborn to escape from the Wailing Prison.
Enervation, previously known as Lower Weapon Crit, is an Alchemy effect in . Its opposing effect is Weapon Critical.
Enchanted Items are items that have an enchantment. These items can include: *Enchanted Armor *Enchanted Weapons *Enchanted Clothing *Amulet *Rings *Enchanted Jewelry **Enchanted Jewelry (Oblivion)
The Everscamp is a type of Lesser Daedra that appears during the quest "Whom Gods Annoy" in . They are a weaker variation of the Scamp that follow the Staff of the Everscamp and its bearer.

Erla is a Redguard smith who works for the Imperial Legion at Moonmoth Legion Fort. Erla is a merchant and will buy and sell armor and weapons, as well as repair items. There are no quests that involve her, nor does she provide unique information.

The Escutcheon of Chorrol is a variant of the Ebony shield awarded for completing the "Sins of the Father" quest by returning the Honorblade of Chorrol to its rightful owners, the royals of Chorrol instead of giving it to Fathis Ules.

Estormo is an Altmer member of the Thalmor. He is encountered inside Labyrinthian after Morokei is killed. He was sent by Ancano to retrieve The Staff of Magnus from the Dragonborn. After a brief conversation with the player, where he congratulates the player for retrieving the staff, he attacks.
Eriana is a Redguard bandit residing in Bloated Man's Grotto. She is one of the Hunters of Hircine sent to kill Sinding. She wears Leather Armor and Hide Bracers with Hide Boots.
Esar-Don Dunsamsi is a Dunmer scout who resides in Tel Vos, Morrowind. He offers medium training in Long Blade and Athletics.
Essence Drain is a passive skill in the Restoration Staff skill line in .
Evasion is an active skill in the Medium Armor skill line in .
Evangeline is a Redguard Blacksmith residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She has a store where she sells hers wares in the indoor market Aldcroft Anvil & Armor, opposite the Dockside Green market.
Erelvam's Wild Sty is a unique Illusion spell available in that obscures the vision of the victim, reducing his chance to hit an opponent with weapon or hand-to-hand attacks.

Eternal Warrior is an item set in . Pieces are Heavy Armor in the Yokudan Style, and can be obtained in Aetherian Archive, Hel Ra Citadel, and Sanctum Ophidia. Items in this set are called Eternal Yokeda.
Essence Thief is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from White Gold Tower and the Daedric Embers Trophy Vault. It is a Medium Armor set, and items are in the Xivkyn Style.
Eternal Vigor is an overland item set in . It is a Heavy Armor Nord Style set, and can be found in Western Skyrim. It may be useful for PvP.

Exclusive Potion of Frost Shield is the highest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental frost around the user's body, increasing resistance to Frost Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Exclusive Potion of Lightning Shield is the highest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental lightning around the user's body, increasing resistance to Shock Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Exclusive Potion of Fire Shield is the highest quality potion available that creates a shield of elemental fire around the user's body, increasing resistance to Fire Damage and inflicting a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Extravagant Right Glove is an unenchanted right glove. It does not provide an armor bonus. Note: Both the left and right versions provide the highest level of enchantment for cloth gloves, as there are no “exquisite” versions in the base game. As with other articles of clothing, they can be worn under any armor pieces (greaves/gloves).

Extravagant Left Glove is an unenchanted left glove. It does not provide an armor bonus. Note: Both the left and right versions provide the highest level of enchantment for cloth gloves, as there are no “exquisite” versions in the base game. As with other articles of clothing, they can be worn under any armor pieces (greaves/gloves).
Eye of Talos is a unique spell in that increases the caster's blunt weapon skill and armor rating.
Evo Othreloth is a Dunmer guard. He is a member of the Royal Guard and is located inside the Throne Room of the Royal Palace of Mournhold. As armor he uses a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Evocation is a passive skill in the Light Armor skill line in .
Explosive Charge is a Templar active ability in the Aedric Spear skill line in . It is a Morphed Ability.
Evinn Chrirnis is a Breton clothier residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found in the indoor market Iron Mine Arms & Armor, selling his wares.

Fa-Nuit-Hen, the Multiplier of Motions Known, is a Demiprince known for his sword-teachings. He is found in his pocket dimension of Oblivion known as Maelstrom Arena, and is assisted by Tutor Riparius. He is known to occasionally visit Mundus, and is said to "haunt warriors who fell and still wonder why."
Exceptional Soul Gem is a miscellaneous item in that can be used to enchant armor, jewelry, and weapons.
Eye of Nahviintaas is a trial item set in . It is a Sunspire style light armor set obtained in Sunspire.
Eydvina Shield-Hearth is a character in / that is a part of the Hendraheim Creation Club addon.

The Fair Helas is a ship that can be found at Ald Velothi docks. It is owned by Galyn Arvel. Fair Helas is used for helping slaves secretly escape Vvardenfell. Because of the Moon Sugar and Skooma presence on board, the ship is also used for smuggling.
Falmer Armor is a unique heavy armor set in . It consists of a helmet, body armor, boots, gauntlets and shield.
The Falmer Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer Armor set found in . The helmet is fashioned from the skull of a Chaurus, the creature from which all Falmer gear is derived.
Fang of Haynekhtnamet is a weapon in . It is a unique dagger found within Mamaea.
Falmer Shield is a heavy shield in that is a part of the Falmer armor set.

Falvillo's Endeavor is a ship found in the docks of Vos, in the Grazelands. It is run by Sedyni Veran. The ship can take the Nerevarine to the Sadrith Mora, Tel Aruhn and Tel Mora. As with most of the other vessels, Falvillo's Endeavor is also used for smuggling ores and drugs.
Falmer Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer armor set found in .
Falmer Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer armor set found in .
Falmer Hardened Armor is a heavy armor set in . Visually identical to Falmer heavy armor, it provides the same protection as Dwarven armor though, slightly lighter.
Falmer Heavy Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer heavy armor set found in .
The Falmer Heavy Helm is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer Heavy Armor set found in . The helm seems to be crafted from the head of a Chaurus hunter.
Falmer Heavy Armor is a set of heavy armor that appears in . It is visually identical to Falmer hardened armor but stronger.
Falmer Hardened Helm is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer hardened armor set found in . It is visually identical to the Falmer heavy helm.
Falmer Hardened Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer hardened armor set found in .
Falmer Heavy Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer heavy armor set found in .
Falmer Hardened Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Falmer hardened armor set found in .
Falx Boots are a piece of heavy armor worn by General Falx Carius. They cannot be obtained without console commands. They have the same appearance as standard Imperial boots.
Falx Gauntlets are a piece of heavy armor worn by General Falx Carius. They cannot be obtained without console commands. They have the same appearance as standard Imperial bracers.
Falx Helmet is a piece of light armor worn by General Falx Carius. It cannot be obtained without console commands. It has the same appearance as a standard Imperial helmet.
Falkwind's Shadewrap is a piece of medium armor rewarded for completing the quest "Peril at the Pools." Is it part of the Shadow of the Red Mountain set.
Far-Walker is an Argonian traveling merchant. She can be found on the road between the Hatching Pools and Hissmir.
False God's Devotion is a trial item set in . It is a Sunspire style light armor set obtained in Sunspire. It is analogous to Vicious Serpent.

Fearstruck was an artifact used by Lyrisius in his battle against the Akaviri invasion. It was a shield given to him by Boethiah, for reasons currently unknown. What is known of this shield, however, is that it was destroyed in a single breath by a wyrm (dragon), when fighting Lyrisius.
Felen's Ebony Staff is a Thieves Guild quest in given by Big Helende. It is the last quest to be given by Helende.
Feather Shield is a light shield that is enchanted to temporarily decrease encumbrance, resulting in a slower loss of Fatigue and an increased capacity to carry items.

Fathasa's Ring is a unique enchanted ring that surrounds the wearer with a shield of fire which provides a fifteen percent resistance to Fire Damage, and inflicts a small amount of damage upon nearby adversaries.

Fenlil is an Altmer chef who resides on Kaleen's ship, where he both lives and works. He sells a variety of food items. He moves with the ship, and is found at the ports of Port Hunding, Betnikh, and Wayrest at different times. If the Vestige talks to him, they will learn what he has been up to since he left the last port.
Feeble Blade is a spell in . The spell reduces the target's attack power.
Fasalla's Guile is an Elite Gear Set in . It can be obtained in Cyrodiil from Elite Gear Vendors. Pieces are heavy Armor in the Abah's Watch Style.
Felicitas Lactucinus is an Imperial found outside The Egg and Hammer Inn at Gideon in .
Fenrik's Journal is a journal in that is part of the Vigil Enforcer Armor Set Creation Club content.

Fire Shield is a spell in that combines the effects Resist Fire and Shield. Its magnitude is considered armor against both physical damage and elemental fire. It protects the user from fire Destruction spells, such as Fire Ball, Flare, and Fire Storm. It comes in both potion and scroll forms. Effectiveness and degree of protection (expressed as a percentage) vary, and the higher quality fire shield potions cost up to a few hundred Septims. They can be found in most Alchemy shops and are also scattered around Cyrodiil's wilderness as random loot.
Fin Gleam is a hidden enchanted helmet that looks identical to a Glass Helmet. Fin Gleam has a somewhat lesser defense, compared to a regular Glass Helmet.

Fighter's Stronghold (DLC) is the ninth and final official downloadable plug-in for from Bethesda. It was released for both the PC and the Xbox 360 on Monday, October 15, 2007, and was free to download for the first week.

Fiery Soul Trap is a weapon enchantment which, as the name suggests, adds both a Soul Trap and a Fire Damage effect. It can be obtained by disenchanting the Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls found in Ironbind Barrow.
Find Roggi Knot-Beard's Ancestral Shield is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must recover an ancestral shield belonging to Roggi Knot-Beard from a dungeon.
Fiend Battle Axe is a two-handed axe that is enchanted to shield the user against Fire Damage, and equip a magical weightless Daedric battle axe that increases Axe skill.
Fiend Katana is a one-handed long blade that is enchanted to shield the user against Fire Damage, and equip a magical weightless Daedric longsword that increases Long Blade skill.
Fine Boots are a clothing item. They provide no protection as armor, but their relatively high weight/value ratio makes them worth collecting to sell. They can be enchanted.
Fine Armguards are a pair of unique light armor gauntlets in .
The Fine Iron Longsword is a one-handed weapon in . It is an upgraded version of the iron longsword.
The Fine Steel Longsword is a one-handed sword in . It is an improved Steel Longsword and is worth more when sold.

The Fine Steel Shortsword is a one-handed weapon in . Its use is governed by the Blade skill. The fine steel shortsword is lighter than the ordinary steel shortsword and does more damage. While it has less reach than the standard Steel Longsword, it causes the same base damage and swings faster, making it a good close in melee weapon.

The Fine Steel Battle Axe is a two-handed weapon in . It is lighter than a Steel Battle Axe, and has higher maximum damage and more health than the Steel Battle Axe does. This weapon's use is governed by the Blunt skill.
The Fine Iron War Axe is an one-handed weapon in . While it has better damage, less weight, higher value and health than the iron war axe, the appearance is the same.
The Fine Steel Bow is a bow in . It is lighter than a silver bow but does equal damage.
The Fine Iron Bow is the lightest bow in Cyrodiil next to a Bound Bow. It is as powerful as a Steel Bow, although it has lower health.
Fine Black Dart is a poisoned throwing weapon that is used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple Sewers. It has higher base damage than standard Black Darts.

Fine Carmine Dart is a poisoned throwing weapon that damages an adversary's Fatigue and Health. This weapon is used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple sewers, and has a higher base damage than standard Carmine Darts.

Fierce Fire Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental fire, providing resistance to Fire Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Fire Barrier is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental fire, providing resistance to Fire Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Fierce Frost Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental frost, providing resistance to Frost Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Fierce Shock Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental shock, providing resistance to Shock Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.
Fifth Barrier is an Alteration spell in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body increasing their armor rating.
Fine Bleeder Dart is a throwing weapon used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple Sewers. It has a higher base damage than standard Bleeder Darts.
Fine Spring Dart is a throwing weapon used by the Black Dart Gang in the Old Mournhold Temple Sewers, and has a higher base damage than standard Spring Darts.
Fiord's Legacy is an overland set in . It can be obtained in Eastmarch. Generic pieces are Medium Armor in the Nord Style.
Fevyn Indarys is a Dunmer student sharpening his sword outside the Temple Canton in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue and does not offer any services.
The Fighter Trainer is a member of Fighters Guild in that provides training services.
Flame Shield is a master-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's fire resistance and armor rating by 30% for 60 seconds.
First Mate Malvulis is a Dunmer pirate and the first mate on the ship Marie Elena, which is docked in the Imperial City Waterfront District.
Filch is the Breton First Mate of the Sea Tub Clarabella, which is a ship docked in Anvil.
Firebite War Axe is an enchanted, one-handed Dwarven axe in .
The Firebite Club is a weapon in . It is an enchanted Chitin Club.

Flawed Dwemer Jinksword is a unique one-handed Dwemer weapon. Although it is flawed, it is a superior jinksword for a vampire Nerevarine who is innately immune its paralysis on self effect. It deals more damage than other short jinkblades, has an extended paralysis effect (five seconds longer than standard), and additional uses before requiring a recharge (six more than standard).
First Barrier is an Alteration spell in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body increasing their armor rating.
The First Mate is a Corsair on the Dainty Sload, a pirate ship anchored near the Solitude Lighthouse.
The Flamecrest Hammer is an enchanted mace in . The Vestige earned this hammer by completing the quest "Retaking Firebrand Keep."
First Mate Kaliq is a Redguard found in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. He is first mate under Captain Currod of the ship The Tava's Bounty, currently in the docks.

Fisherman's Island is a crafting location that appears in the region of Stormhaven in . The outdoor crafting allow the creation of the Seducer Set armor. In order to craft and item for the Armor of the Seducer, each piece must have three traits researched for it.
Flanking Strategist is an overland item set found in . It is a Medium Armor set obtained in the Gold Coast. Pieces are in the Order of the Hour Style.
First Mate Irielis is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is found aboard the ship heading to Tempest Island.
First Mate Ulveni is a Dunmer residing in Firemoth in Vvardenfell. He appears only on the slaver's ship, during the quest "Broken Bonds" as a hostile character.
Flashing is Prince Attrebus' sword. He used it during the Umbriel Crisis to fight the many threats that Sul and him faced.
First Mate Iribia is a Breton sailor of the Bjoulsae Queen, a ship in Evermore.
Flame Blossom is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Bloodroot Forge. It is a Light Armor set, and items are in the Bloodforge Style.

The Fishing Rod is a tool and one-handed weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing. It can be used to catch fish (or rubbish) at fishing spots found throughout Skyrim and Solstheim. It is based on the Fishing Pole.
Forgotten Names is an unmarked quest available in in which the Dragonborn must discover the purpose of a mysterious Daedric Gauntlet located underneath the College of Winterhold in The Midden.

A forge is a crafting station found in that allows the creation of armor, weapons and jewelry via the Smithing skill. The armor and weapon types are unlocked by leveling up the Smithing skill and then choosing the perks that go with it. Forges often include grindstones, which can improve weapons, and a workbench to improve armor. Some forges have a smelter nearby, but not all. Some forges are unique in that they are the only way to forge special weapons or armor.
Forsworn Armor is a set of light armor found in . It is worn by members of the Forsworn. This armor is equivalent to leather armor in terms of armor rating and weight.
Forsworn Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Forsworn armor set found in .
The Forsworn Headdress is a piece of light armor and part of the Forsworn armor set found in .
Forsworn Gauntlets are a piece of light armor and part of the Forsworn armor set found in .

The Forsworn Staff is a staff used by the Forsworn. It appears as a crude wooden staff decorated with animal teeth and topped with two bird skulls and a bundle of feathers bound together with cord. It is identical to the Eye of Melka.

The Fork is a one-handed weapon in . It is essentially a standard two-pronged dinner fork that can be found all over Skyrim. Unlike other forks, this variant can be equipped as a weapon. It is the weakest weapon available and will always deal a base damage of 1 as the One-Handed skill does not govern this weapon. It cannot be upgraded at a grindstone; however, it can be enchanted.
Forgotten Shipwreck is a ship in , located in the West Gash region. It can be found north of Arkngthunch-Sturdumz and west of Ald Velothi.
The Flying Viper is a throwing weapon in that causes poison damage and fortifies marksmanship when it strikes an opponent.
Focused Charge is a Templar active skill in the Aedric Spear skill line in .
Follow Up is a passive skill in the Two Handed skill line in . Prior to Update 5, this skill was known as Arcane Fighter.
Forsworn Weapons are a type of weapon set available in . Forsworn weapons do not include daggers, maces or two-handed weapons.

Footman's Fortune is an item set that appears in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found by defeating enemies and bosses throughout Dragonstar Arena. It can also be traded or bought from other players.
Fondryn Dalen is a Dunmer fighter residing in Tel Branora, in Vvardenfell. She can be seen walking between the plants in the centre of the settlement.

Fonten Jodain is a Breton drunkard first encountered on Vvardenfell in a ship sailing to it. He is the first character met if "Soul Shriven in Coldharbour" is skipped in . If the Vestige first begins outside Vvardenfell, Fonten Jodain will be found dead, with the Good Travels! note beside him.
Foolkiller's Ward is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Waking Flame Style set, and can be found in The Cauldron.
Forsworn Shaman's Note is a note in that is a part of the Spell Knight Armor Creation Club content.
Force Shock is an active skill in the Destruction Staff skill line in .
Force Siphon is an active skill in the Restoration Staff skill line in .

The Fractured Humerus is a miscellaneous item. It can be found in the crematorium of Ebrocca after pushing a switch. It is hidden under a Leather Shield in Ebrocca, Descenia on the table in the first room. Humerus is the scientific term for the bone in the upper arm, but in popular culture is often assumed or joked to instead be the scientific name for the Ulnar nerve or 'funny bone'.
Fortify Conjuration is an Alchemy and Enchanting effect found on certain ingredients and armor in .

Fortify Smithing is a property of alchemical ingredients and enchanted apparel. It only affects the improvement of weapons and armor at grindstones and workbenches, not the creation of these items at a forge. __TOC__
Fortify Light Armor is an alchemy effect found on certain ingredients in . It is also an enchantment effect.

Fortify Sneak is both an Alchemical Effect (found on certain ingredients) and an enchantment effect in . Potions/Enchanted armor with this effect may be created at an Alchemy Labs/Enchanting Table or purchased from alchemist merchants/Blacksmiths.
Fortify Heavy Armor is an Alchemy effect, and an Enchantment that is found in . __TOC__
Fortify Block is an alchemical and enchanting effect found on certain ingredients, potions and enchanted armor.
Fortify Stamina is an alchemical and enchanting effect found on certain ingredients and armor in . __TOC__
Fourth Barrier is an Alteration spell in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body increasing their armor rating.
Fortress is a passive skill in the One Hand and Shield skill line in .
Fortify Axe Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of axe. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Heavy Armor Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of heavy armor. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Light Armor Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of light armor. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Long Blade Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of long blade. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Medium Armor Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of medium armor. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Short Blade Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of short blade. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fortify Spear Skill is a Restoration spell in that temporarily increases the value of spear. The skill returns to its original value when the spell ends.
Fracture, previously known as Lower Armor, is an Alchemy effect in . Its opposing effect is Increase Armor.
Friar Hadelar is a hostile Altmer member of Bronzefists found in Nchuleftingth on Vvardenfell. Paired with Renduril the Hammer, they are considered a dungeon boss.

Fundaments of Alchemy is a book written by Alyandon Mathierry. It details the fundamentals of the craft of Alchemy, as the title suggests. Relatively inexpensive, all the Mages Guild halls in Cyrodiil carry many copies. Bookstores sell them as well.
Fur Armor is the weakest armor in , though it is also the lightest. It is made out of animal furs, and is very common.
Frost Shield is a spell and spell effect available in that protects the user from frost spells such as Frost and Ice Storm. The Frost shield effect combines the effects Resist Frost and Shield.
Frost Shell is an apprentice-level Alteration spell in . Upon cast, it increases the caster's frost resistance and armor rating by 10% for 30 seconds.
Fur Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Fur Armor set found in .

Froki Whetted-Blade is an Elder Nord hunter residing in his shack with his grandson, Haming. Froki is reclusive by nature and prefers to keep away from city folk. He vehemently rejects Alessia's Cyrodilic pantheon of the Eight Divines, calling them stolen or imposter gods. Rather, he follows the Nordic Pantheon with a particular liking towards Kyne, the warrior-widow of Shor. He is also the father of Torolf, a resident of Helgen who was killed during Alduin's attack. Torolf's son, Haming, was left an orphan, and Froki took it upon himself to care for his grandchild.

Frostbite Venom is a common poison that can be applied to any weapon including conjured ones, but not spells. Once applied, the next hit will deliver the poison to the target, but will not be used if the weapon hits a wall, for example. (These rules apply to all other poisons as well. See here for full list)
Friga Shatter-Shield was a Nord and the daughter of Tova Shatter-Shield and Torbjorn Shatter-Shield of Clan Shatter-Shield in the city of Windhelm.
Froki's Bow is a unique Long Bow in . It once belonged to Froki, an elderly hunter who is now living in The Rift.
Fultheim is a Nord who stays at the Nightgate Inn. He possesses a Blades Sword. The innkeeper Hadring explains that Fultheim is at the inn "drinking away a lifetime of bad memories."
Fur Helmet is the lightest known helmet. It is made out of animal fur and is very common. There are two types of fur helmets, the regular one and one used at the Arena in the Arena District.
Fur Gauntlets are light gauntlets that are a part of the Fur armor set.
Fur Shield is a shield in . As the lightest shield, it belongs to the Fur Armor set. Using it in battle increases the Light Armor and Block skills.

Frost-Ghost is a ship found in . It is a small, open boat of the Dunmer Ano Andaram in the Foreign Quarter of Vivec City. The Frost-Ghost provides transportation to Ebonheart, Hla Oad, Molag Mar and Tel Branora.
Fur Bracers are a piece of light armor and part of the Fur Armor set found in .
Fur Shoes are a piece of light armor and part of the fur armor set found in .
Frostgore is a unique one-handed short blade that is enchanted with Frost Damage.

Frost Barrier is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental frost, providing resistance to Frost Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.
Gabrielle's Staff of Healing is a restoration staff that the Vestige receives as a reward after completing the quest "Mastering the Talisman."
Fuldir is a Nord warrior found at the Baandari Trading Post. He was ambushed by Ra Gada bandits while on the road and lost his shield and is seeking help in retrieving it.

Full-Leather Armor is a type of medium armor in . It is the fourth type of medium armor available to craft in the Clothing skill line. The Full-Leather Armor is the appropriate armor for levels 36-45.

Furnishing Materials are crafting items in . Furnishing materials are required to craft various types of furnishing. All furnishing materials can be obtained from resource nodes or as random loot from containers and creatures.
Frozen Watcher is a dungeon set in . It is a Heavy Armor Meridian Style set, and can be found in Depths of Malatar. It references the Stone Watchers found throughout the dungeon.
Galbedir is a Bosmer enchanter in the Balmora Mages Guild. She appears to have a severe grudge against Ajira. She has the ability to train the Nerevarine in Unarmored, Destruction, and Alchemy.
Galdal Omayn is a Dunmer living in the Ghostgate. She wears a full suit of glass armor, along with a rare mask, the Daedric Face of Inspiration.
Gaston Tussaud is the captain of the ship Marie Elena, ported in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City.

Garakh is an Orsimer blacksmith in Largashbur. She can be found near the forge or inside Largashbur Longhouse, and does not buy or sell items. She dutifully carries out her job, dedicating every item she crafts to honoring Malacath. She hopes to ready her apprentice Lob to be ready to carry on her responsibility when he is ready. During the events of "The Cursed Tribe," she will state that she believes that the tribe has angered Malacath and that they must be punished for it.
Garnikh's Bite is a One-Handed Axe received after completing the quest "Prove Your Worth."
Gallant Chain is an upper body heavy armor the Vestige receive after completing the quest "Tip of the Spearhead."
Galerion's Spare Staff is an inferno staff earned after completing Breaking the Shackle.
Galerion's Revenge is a Tel Var set in . It can be bought from Tel Var merchants. Pieces are Light Armor in the High Elf Style.
The Gauntlets of Gluttony are a unique pair of enchanted iron gauntlets sold by Fjotreid at Hammer and Axe in Bruma.
The Gauntlet is the day in which the Dunmer summon Boethiah. It falls on the 2nd of Sun's Dusk.
